title: Pure Light and Darkness Ritual
summary: The Light and Darkness Ritual cards with Ragged Records of Rites, Black Skull Dragon, and generic staples, built to play the page's combo lines. The deck focuses on summoning Level 8 Ritual bosses that remain unaffected by opponent monster effects unless targeted, backed by continuous GY recursion.

summary.title: Starters & Searchers
points: Black Chaos: Shuffles a Ritual Monster from hand or GY into the Deck to Special Summon itself, discards itself to place Mind Shuffle from Deck, and banishes up to two cards on field when tributed.
Celtic Mystic: On summon draws three cards and discards two cards including a LIGHT or DARK monster, and can tribute itself to Special Summon a Ritual Monster directly from hand.

Griffoh: Discards itself to Set a Quick-Play Spell or Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual directly from Deck with permission to activate it that turn, and counts as the entire Level 8 Ritual tribute.
Ragged Records of Rites: Reveals Light and Darkness Ritual in hand to add a monster that mentions it from Deck to hand.

Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity: Beyond the Brave support monster that discards a Quick-Play Spell or Ritual Spell to Special Summon itself and Sets a Light and Darkness Spell or Trap from Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Griffoh and Ritual Setup
steps: Discard Griffoh to Set Mind Shuffle or Chaos Magical Hats directly from your Deck.
Activate Mind Shuffle to add Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness or Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos from Deck to hand.
Activate Light and Darkness Ritual, tributing Griffoh from the field or banishing materials from the GY to Ritual Summon your Level 8 Ritual boss.
Activate Light and Darkness Ritual's GY effect during the End Phase to recycle itself and another card back to hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness: Banishes a card on the field on summon, cannot be destroyed by battle, attacks twice, and is unaffected by non-targeting activated effects.
Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos: Recovers a Spell from the GY on summon, banishes an opponent's card face-down when a Spell is activated, and protects your Spells and Traps from destruction.
Skull Archfiend of Chaos: Summons itself by recycling three banished or GY cards, and when sent to the GY, sends Light and Darkness Ritual to search a Ritual Monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Light and Darkness Ritual: Dedicated Ritual Spell that can tribute from hand/field or banish materials from the GY, returning itself and another card to hand each turn.
Mind Shuffle: Searches monsters mentioning the Ritual Spell, and during the opponent's turn, quick-tags a Level 7 or higher monster on field for another from your hand or Deck.
Spell Shattering Sword: Destroys all face-up Spells your opponent controls, or targets an opponent's monster to reduce its ATK to 0 and negate its effects.
Chaos Magical Hats and Chaos Mystic Box: Defensive Quick-Play Spells that redirect opponent targeting effects, generate board presence, and destroy opposing cards.

allow.Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Uni: Beyond the Brave support: discards a Quick-Play or Ritual Spell to summon itself and Sets a Spell/Trap that mentions Light and Darkness Ritual.
